title: Posterior state
description: The model's current belief about Liverpool's tactical identity under Iraola, as of a given matchweek. Same shape as manager_prior.schema.json (continuous_metrics, formation_prior) plus an update_log showing how each matchweek moved the belief -- this log is what makes the 'model learning over the season' story visible and auditable.

continuous_metrics.description: Posterior values after folding in observed matches via Normal-Normal conjugate updates. Mean and variance are combined by precision (inverse variance). observation_variance records the single-match noise used so sequential updates remain consistent; effective_n records the equivalent sample count.

effective_n.description: pseudo_n + observations incorporated for this metric.

observation_variance.description: Single-match noise variance used for this metric's conjugate updates.

formation_prior.description: Dirichlet posterior: prior alpha counts + observed formation counts this season.

update_log.description: One entry per matchweek update. This is the audit trail -- what changed and why -- that a recruiter could actually read.

metrics_observed.description: Raw observed values that fed into this update, e.g. {'possession': 47.2, 'ppda': 8.1}

sources.description: Source records copied from the reviewed match observation.

notable_shifts.description: Plain-language notes, e.g. 'possession posterior mean dropped 2.1pts toward Bournemouth prior after two consecutive low-possession wins'
